The counts of Namur were tied in turn to the houses of Flanders and Hainaut, Courtenay, Luxembourg and Dampierre. In 1256 Henry V of Luxembourg seized the county in the absence of Baldwin II of Courtenay, then busy in Constantinople, and Guy of Dampierre, count of Flanders, won it back by marrying Henry's daughter. His grandsons John II and Philip III and then William the Rich followed each other quickly, until John III, the last count, sold the county in 1421 to Philip the Good of Burgundy. The city's arms became a crowned lion, to distinguish the Namur lion from the Flemish, Brabantine and Hainaut ones.

Namur became part of the Burgundian Netherlands, and after the death of Charles the Bold in 1477 it came under the Habsburgs, lying on a shifting frontier between France and Austria. Around 1420 the harvests failed badly in the Namur region. From the sixteenth century the importance of its military role grew, thanks to its position at the confluence of two waterways, and a fortress system developed to replace the older walls.

Charles V's walls were thickened by the Dutch, and later Menno van Coehoorn and Vauban improved the defences. Louis XIV took Namur in 1692, and the Dutch retook it in 1695; Coehoorn strengthened the forts again afterwards. The diocese of Namur was created in 1559. The Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle of 1748 made the Austrian Netherlands a buffer state, and Joseph II ordered the fortress dismantled and the forts sold, so that the French revolutionary armies of 1792 found a weaker city than their predecessors.
simp_chinese:
那慕尔位于桑布尔河与默兹河交汇处，罗马人的聚落在名为格罗尼翁的地点发展起来，悬崖上的城堡俯瞰着两条河。那慕尔伯爵先后与佛兰德、埃诺、库特奈、卢森堡和当皮埃尔等家族有关联。1256年，卢森堡的亨利五世趁库特奈的鲍德温二世在君士坦丁堡忙碌之机夺取了该伯国，佛兰德伯爵居伊·德·当皮埃尔通过迎娶亨利之女夺回了它。他的孙子约翰二世、菲利普三世，继而是“富者”威廉先后迅速继位，直到末代伯爵约翰三世于1421年把伯国卖给勃艮第的好人菲利普。城徽随之成为头戴王冠的狮子，以区别于佛兰德、布拉班特和埃诺的狮子。

那慕尔归入勃艮第尼德兰，1477年大胆查理去世后归哈布斯堡家族，处在法国和奥地利之间不断变动的边界上。1420年前后，那慕尔地区收成很差。从16世纪起，由于地处两条水道的交汇处，它的军事作用日益重要，一套要塞体系逐步取代了旧城墙。

查理五世修筑的城墙被荷兰人加厚，后来梅嫩·范·库霍恩和沃邦又改进了防御。路易十四于1692年夺取那慕尔，荷兰人1695年夺回，库霍恩随后再次加强各座堡垒。那慕尔主教区设立于1559年。1748年的《亚琛和约》把奥属尼德兰设为缓冲国，约瑟夫二世下令拆除要塞、出售堡垒，因此1792年法国革命军面对的城市比先前的军队防御要弱。

english: Namweraha Point lies by the eastern Solomon Islands in the Pacific, near the shores of Makira. Its communities maintained exchange links with Ulawa and southern Malaita before European visits. In 1568 Álvaro de Mendaña’s expedition reached Makira and explored portions of its coast.
simp_chinese: 纳姆韦拉哈角位于所罗门群岛东部，靠近马基拉海岸。欧洲人到访之前，当地社群已与乌拉瓦和马莱塔南部维持交换联系。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的船队抵达马基拉，考察了部分海岸。

english: Namwŏn stands in an inland basin of Chŏlla, near the routes leading east through Korea's southern mountains. Its town wall was begun on King Sŏngjong's orders in 1477 and completed before 1492. During the renewed Japanese invasion of 1597, the fortress became the scene of a major battle as the invaders advanced into Chŏlla. Its defences placed the town at the centre of the struggle for the province.
simp_chinese: 南原位于全罗道内陆盆地，靠近向东穿越朝鲜南部山地的道路。成宗于1477年下令修筑邑城，城墙在1492年前完成。1597年日军再次入侵并向全罗道进军时，南原城成为一场大战的战场。城郭防御使南原处于争夺本道的中心。

english: Namy lies on the left bank of the Omoloy, north of the Arctic Circle. The river rises in the Verkhoyansk mountain system and flows north beside the Kular Range before crossing the coastal lowland to Buor-Khaya Gulf. Snow and rain feed its waters, which freeze in autumn and open again in early summer. This river valley links the northern mountains with the tundra approaching the Laptev Sea.
simp_chinese: 纳米位于北极圈以北的奥莫洛伊河左岸。奥莫洛伊河发源于上扬斯克山系，沿库拉尔山脉向北流淌，穿过海岸低地后注入布奥尔—哈亚湾。河水由雨雪补给，秋季封冻，初夏解冻。河谷将北方山地与接近拉普捷夫海的苔原联系起来。

english:
Namysłów lies on the Widawa, on the road between Wrocław and Kraków. Refounded after the Mongol invasion of 1241, it developed as a trading town whose brewers and clothmakers supplied its markets. Its castle, recorded in 1312, was a residence of King Casimir III of Poland during the shifting divisions of Silesia.

In 1348 Casimir and Charles IV of Bohemia concluded the Treaty of Namysłów here, settling claims to Silesia. The town resisted a Hussite siege in 1428, but was plundered by Swedish troops after a long and destructive siege during the Thirty Years' War. Emperor Leopold I gave the castle to the Teutonic Order in 1703, and it became the seat of a commandery. Namysłów passed to Prussia in 1742 after the First Silesian War.
simp_chinese:
纳梅斯武夫位于维达瓦河畔，坐落在弗罗茨瓦夫与克拉科夫之间的道路上。1241年蒙古入侵之后，城镇重新建立，发展为商贸之地；酿酒师和制呢匠为市场供应货物。当地城堡见于1312年的记载，在西里西亚诸公国不断分合的时期，曾是波兰国王卡齐米日三世的驻地。

1348年，卡齐米日与波希米亚国王查理四世在此签署《纳梅斯武夫条约》，解决双方对西里西亚的主张。1428年，城镇抵抗了胡斯派的围攻；三十年战争期间，瑞典军队却在长期围困后劫掠了这里。1703年，皇帝利奥波德一世将城堡赐给条顿骑士团，骑士团在此设立指挥区。1742年，第一次西里西亚战争后，纳梅斯武夫归属普鲁士。

english:
Nan stands in a mountain-ringed valley on the river that bears its name. Its rulers descended from the Phukha dynasty of Pua, an older centre farther upstream. The town became the seat of a northern Tai principality, while Buddhist shrines such as Phra That Chae Haeng on the eastern side of the valley testified to its ties with Sukhothai and the wider religious world of the region.

In the fourteenth century the court moved south from Pua to Chae Haeng and then, in 1368, to the site of Wiang Nan. Earth walls and moats protected the settlement as it grew beside the river. Nan maintained close connections with Sukhothai, but in the middle of the fifteenth century King Tilokaraj of Chiang Mai brought it under the authority of Lan Na. The town later passed under Burmese domination along with other northern centres, before its rulers regained a place among the northern principalities allied to Siam.
simp_chinese:
难府坐落在群山环绕的难河谷地。这里的统治者出自上游较古老中心磨府的普卡王朝。城镇成为北方泰族政体的治所，谷地东侧的帕塔寨亨等佛教圣地则见证了它与素可泰及更广泛宗教世界的联系。

十四世纪，王廷从磨府南迁至寨亨，1368年又移至威昂难所在地。随着城镇在河畔发展，土墙和护城壕保护着聚落。难府与素可泰关系密切，但十五世纪中叶，清迈国王提洛加叻使其归入兰纳的权威之下。后来，难府与其他北方中心一样落入缅甸统治，之后当地君主又在与暹罗结盟的北方诸邦中恢复了地位。

english: Nana Kahinga lies southwest of Mwinilunga in the country of the upper Zambezi. The Zambezi rises north of Mwinilunga in a marshy dambo among miombo woodland, near the watershed separating it from the Congo basin. West of this country the Nyambwezi Falls descend beside a rock shelter bearing ancient engravings.
simp_chinese: 纳纳卡欣加位于姆维尼伦加西南方的赞比西河上游地区。赞比西河发源于姆维尼伦加以北米翁博林地中的浅沼湿地，靠近与刚果盆地的分水岭。这片地区西面的尼安布韦齐瀑布旁有一处岩棚，留有古老的刻画。

english: Nana Kandungu lies in the upper Zambezi country of eastern Angola. The name is also recorded as Kavungo and Nana Candundo. Here the river and its tributaries wind through a landscape of woodland, grassland and seasonally flooded ground. The upper Zambezi's many streams drain the Angolan plateau before the river turns south towards the great floodplain of western Zambia.
simp_chinese: 纳纳坎敦古位于安哥拉东部的赞比西河上游地区，名称也写作卡文戈和纳纳坎敦多。主河及其支流蜿蜒穿过林地、草原与季节性洪泛地。赞比西河上游的众多水道排泄安哥拉高原的水源，主流随后转向南方，流向赞比亚西部的广大洪泛平原。

english: Nan'an lies south of Weichu in the mountains of central Yunnan. The settlement was once known as Mochu, a name associated with the people who lived there before the Yuan conquest. The Yuan first established a military office at Mochu and in 1275 replaced it with Nan'an Prefecture, subordinate to Weichu. The name meant the southern part of the Weichu country. Under both the Ming and Qing, Nan'an remained a prefecture within Chuxiong, preserving its place as a local centre in the uplands.
simp_chinese: 南安位于滇中山地，在威楚之南。这里旧称摩刍，是元朝征服以前当地居民聚居的地方。元初在摩刍设置千户，1275年改置南安州，隶属威楚路；南安之名便取其位于威楚之南。明清时期，南安州继续隶属楚雄府，作为山地中的地方治所延续下来。

english: Nán’ān lies in southern Fújiàn, with coastal settlements facing the island of Jīnmén. Among them is Shíjǐng, the ancestral home of Zhèng Chénggōng, known in the West as Koxinga. In 1646, after his father submitted to the Qīng, Zhèng is said to have burned his scholar’s robes at the Confucian temple in Fēngzhōu before taking up arms.
simp_chinese: 南安位于福建南部，其沿海聚落隔海面向金门。其中的石井是郑成功的祖籍地。1646年，父亲降清后，郑成功据说在丰州孔庙焚毁儒服，随后起兵抗清。

english: The Nanatsoho were a Caddo people of the Red River country. In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries their villages lay near those of the Kadohadacho and upper Nasoni, with whom they formed part of a larger group of related communities. The river linked settlements on its banks through a region of forests and fertile bottomlands. By the early nineteenth century the Nanatsoho had become closely joined with neighboring Caddo communities.
simp_chinese: 纳纳措霍人是红河地区的卡多民族。十七至十八世纪，他们的村落与卡多哈达乔人及上游纳索尼人的村落相邻，共同组成关系密切的社群。红河穿过森林与肥沃低地，将两岸聚落联系起来。到十九世纪初，纳纳措霍人与邻近的卡多社群日益融合。

english: Nanboa Angonga lies in the hills east of Quibala, near the Binga River and Quilemba mountain. The streams of the Quibala country include the Longa and Lonhe, which cut through the western Angolan highlands. Beyond the hills to the west, the land descends towards the Atlantic coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 楠博阿安贡加位于奎巴拉以东的丘陵，靠近宾加河和基伦巴山。奎巴拉地区的河流包括隆加河与洛涅河，它们穿过安哥拉西部高地。越过西面的丘陵，地势逐渐下降，通向大西洋沿岸平原。

sources.title: Introducing the highlands and escarpments of Angola and Namibia.pdf

english: Nanbu lies on the middle Jialing River south of Langzhong, among the low hills of northern Sichuan. The river and its tributaries wind between cultivated valleys and settlements. The county's name dates back to the Southern Dynasties; after periods of administrative change, the Ming restored Nanbu County in 1380. Its place on the Jialing kept it connected with the towns upstream and the larger basin downstream.
simp_chinese: 南部位于阆中以南的嘉陵江中游，四周是川北低丘。嘉陵江及支流曲折穿过田地和聚落所在的谷地。县名可追溯到南朝，历经建置变迁后，明朝于1380年复置南部县。嘉陵江将它与上游城镇和下游盆地联系起来。

english:
Nanchang stands on the Gan River plain southwest of Poyang Lake, where the rivers of Jiangxi meet the water road to the Yangtze. Under the Yuan it was the seat of the Jiangxi provincial government. The riverside Tengwang Pavilion, made famous by Wang Bo's Tang-dynasty preface, gave the city a literary name that outlasted many ruinings and rebuildings.

In 1363 Chen Youliang, rival of the future Ming founder Zhu Yuanzhang, besieged the city, then called Hongdu. Zhu's nephew held it until Zhu's main fleet arrived and broke Chen on Poyang Lake, and Zhu renamed the place Nanchang that year. Under the Ming the city housed both the provincial offices and the court of the Prince of Ning. In 1519 the prince rose in rebellion here and sailed downriver toward Anqing, but the scholar-official Wang Shouren seized his undefended base and defeated him. Jiangxi merchants grew into one of the empire's great trading networks, and in 1595 the Jesuit Matteo Ricci settled in Nanchang for three years among its officials and princes. In 1649 the Qing retook the city from a general who had rebelled against them, and sacked it.
simp_chinese:
南昌位于赣江平原、鄱阳湖西南，江西各水系在此汇向长江水道。元代江西行省的治所设在这里。临江的滕王阁因唐代王勃的《滕王阁序》而闻名，使这座城市历经毁建而文名不坠。

1363年，后来建立明朝的朱元璋的对手陈友谅围攻当时称洪都的南昌。朱元璋的侄子朱文正坚守城池，直到朱元璋的大军赶到，在鄱阳湖击败陈友谅，当年洪都改称南昌。明代南昌既是江西的省城，又是宁王的封地。1519年，宁王在这里起兵，沿江东下进攻安庆，王守仁却趁机攻占了他空虚的老巢，将其击败。江右商帮成为明清时期的大商帮之一；1595年，耶稣会士利玛窦来到南昌，在城中住了三年，结交官员与宗室。1649年，清军从反清的将领手中夺回南昌，城遭屠戮。

english:
Nancheng was the seat of Jianchang Prefecture in eastern Jiangxi, on the Xu River. Its streets, official buildings and temples formed the centre of a district extending toward the mountains of Fujian. The river could be crossed by floating bridge, but floods made that passage uncertain.

In 1634 a period of heavy rain raised the river, and an overloaded boat crossing it sank with the loss of thirty-three lives. Local people began building a stone bridge the following year. Work continued through the fall of the Ming and was completed in 1647 under the Qing. Known as Wannian Bridge, its twenty-three arches spanned the Xu in red stone, replacing the vulnerable crossing with a lasting work of masonry.
simp_chinese:
南城位于江西东部旴江边，是建昌府治。街市、官署和庙宇构成地方中心，府境向东延伸至闽赣山地。江上曾设浮桥，但洪水常使渡河变得艰难。

1634年久雨江涨，一次渡船事故造成三十三人溺亡。次年，当地开始修建石桥，工程跨越明清易代，至1647年竣工。万年桥以红石砌成，二十三孔横跨旴江，取代了容易受水患影响的旧渡。

english:
Nanchong belongs to the Jialing River country of Sichuan, where fertile valleys and surrounding hills supported a substantial agricultural economy. Farmers supplied grain, silk related products and other goods, while river transport connected settlements with larger markets downstream. Roads and boats brought merchants, officials and travellers into contact with local producers across the wider Shunqing region.

Nanchong served as the seat of Shunqing prefecture under the Ming and Qing. Early in the Ming, the prefectural city was moved from the Beijin ferry area; its walls were later expanded and faced with brick and stone, with the Jialing River on the eastern side. The upheavals of the seventeenth century severely affected Sichuan, followed by recovery and migration under Qing rule. Markets and transport routes connected villages and towns across the region.
simp_chinese:
南充属于四川嘉陵江地区，肥沃河谷与周围丘陵支撑规模可观的农业经济。农民供应粮食、蚕丝相关产品及其他货物，河运把聚落同较大下游市场连接起来。道路和船只使商人、官员及旅客在广大顺庆地区与地方生产者接触。

明清时期，南充是顺庆府治所。明初府城从北津渡一带迁移，后来扩建并以砖石包砌城墙，东侧依傍嘉陵江。十七世纪的动荡严重影响四川，清代随后经历恢复与人口迁徙。市场和交通路线将地区内的村庄与城镇联系起来。

english: Nanchuan lies among the mountains south of the Yangtze, beneath the cliffs of Jinfo Mountain. Its sheer rock faces and high plateau gave the mountain a place in local lore: the county gazetteer compared the cliffs, lit by the setting sun, to golden Buddhas. Jinfo Temple, traditionally said to have been founded in the Tang period, flourished in the Ming, when Buddhist teachers continued to visit and write about the mountain.
simp_chinese: 南川位于长江以南的群山间，金佛山的峭壁高踞其境。高原和绝壁在地方传说中占有一席之地：县志将夕阳照耀下的山壁比作金佛。金佛寺相传始建于唐代，明代香火兴盛；僧人到山中弘法，也留下了描写山景的诗篇。

english:
Nancy was the capital of the dukes of Lorraine. Its medieval old town, with the ducal palace, stood beside a newer town laid out on straighter streets under Duke Charles III. Walls and open ground separated the two, reflecting both the city's growth and the need to defend it in a contested borderland.

In 1477 Duke René II defeated Charles the Bold of Burgundy outside Nancy; Charles was killed, ending his attempt to hold the city. Centuries later Stanislas Leszczyński, the former king of Poland who became duke of Lorraine in 1737, set about reshaping the capital. He commissioned the architect Emmanuel Héré to create a royal square between the old and new towns. Inaugurated in 1755, it honoured his son-in-law Louis XV of France. On Stanislas's death in 1766, Lorraine passed to the French Crown.
simp_chinese:
南锡是洛林公爵的首府。拥有公爵宫的中世纪旧城，与查理三世公爵时期按笔直街道规划的新城相邻；两者之间有城防和空地，既反映城市扩展，也反映边疆防御的需要。

1477年，勒内二世公爵在南锡城外击败勃艮第的大胆查理，查理阵亡，其占据城市的企图随之结束。几个世纪后，前波兰国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基于1737年成为洛林公爵，着手改造首府。他委托建筑师埃马纽埃尔·埃雷在新旧城之间设计皇家广场，1755年落成，以纪念他的女婿法国国王路易十五。1766年斯坦尼斯瓦夫去世后，洛林归入法国王室。

english: Nandagiri rises north of Bangalore as a steep hill fortress also known as Nandidurga. Its summit contains a temple of Yoga Nandishvara and looks over the surrounding plateau. The heights served as a retreat for Tipu Sultan and as a strong defensive position during the wars of Mysore. In October 1791, during the Third Anglo-Mysore War, British forces under Cornwallis attacked the fortress. Nandidurga had a reputation for great strength, yet the attackers stormed it after a siege. Its fall deprived Tipu of a commanding stronghold north of Bangalore while the campaign moved toward his capital at Srirangapatna.
simp_chinese: 难陀吉里是班加罗尔以北陡峭的山堡，也称难陀杜尔伽。山顶建有瑜伽难提湿伐罗神庙，俯瞰周围高原。这里曾是蒂普苏丹的避暑之处，也是迈索尔战争中的坚固防御据点。1791年10月，第三次英迈战争期间，康沃利斯率英国军队进攻要塞。难陀杜尔伽素以坚固著称，但进攻者围城后仍强攻得手。堡垒陷落使蒂普失去班加罗尔以北的一处制高点，战事随后向他的首都室利兰伽帕特纳推进。

english: Nandan lies among the mountains of northwestern Guangxi, on the approaches to Guizhou. Its name was recorded in the Song period and was associated with the cinnabar presented to the court as tribute. The Mo family held authority here for centuries, their hereditary office surviving changes of dynasty and forming one of the longest-lasting native chieftaincies in Guangxi. In 1374, the early Ming government incorporated several neighbouring prefectures into Nandan. The family’s authority endured under the Qing: surviving appointments issued by the Nandan native prefect in the Jiaqing reign show local officeholders receiving their commissions from the hereditary ruler.
simp_chinese: 南丹坐落在广西西北的群山之中，扼通往贵州的道路。南丹之名见于宋代，与当地向朝廷进贡的丹砂有关。莫氏家族在此掌权数百年，其世袭土官历经朝代更替，是广西延续最久的土司之一。明洪武七年（1374年），朝廷将周边数州并入南丹。莫氏的权力在清代延续下来：留存至今的嘉庆年间委任文书，展示了地方官役如何由南丹土州官任命。

english: Nandan was a district in the mountain country north of Yingjiang, west of the Gaoligong range. Its old seat lay at Mengnong, among valleys watered by tributaries of the Daying River. The wider region was home to Tai communities and hereditary chiefs whose territories shifted during the struggles between Luchuan and the Ming. Forested slopes enclose the small basins, while rivers lead south and west toward the lands beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese: 南赕位于盈江以北、高黎贡山以西的山地，旧治在勐弄，附近河谷由大盈江支流滋养。这一带居住着傣族社群，地方土司的辖地随麓川与明朝之间的战争而变化。林木覆盖的山坡环抱小盆地，河流向南、西流往群山之外。

english:
Nandapur lies in the highlands of southern Odisha, where it was the seat of the Silavamshi rulers and the early capital of the kingdom later known as Jeypore. Among its relics is the Batrisa Simhasana, a throne of thirty-two steps associated with the legendary king Vikramaditya. Temples and images at the old capital recall the religious traditions of the region.

The Silavamshi king Ganga Raja ruled from Nandapur in the fourteenth century. In the fifteenth century Vinayak Deo, who married a daughter of the ruling family, inherited the kingdom and founded the line of the later Jeypore rulers. His successors held a broad territory extending from the inland hills toward the coastal plains. In the sixteenth century Vishwanath Deo shifted the royal seat to Rayagada; by 1571 his successor had accepted the overlordship of Golconda and paid tribute to its sultans.
simp_chinese:
南达普尔位于奥里萨南部高地，曾是希拉王朝的驻地，也是后来称为杰布尔王国的早期都城。遗迹中有一座三十二级宝座，传说与维克拉玛蒂亚王有关。旧都的寺庙与神像留下了这一地区宗教传统的印记。

十四世纪，希拉王朝的甘加·拉贾从南达普尔统治。十五世纪，娶了王室公主的维纳亚克·德奥继承王国，建立了后来杰布尔统治者的家系。他的继承者控制的广阔土地从内陆丘陵延伸至沿海平原。十六世纪，毗湿瓦纳特·德奥将王座迁往拉亚加达；到1571年，其继承者已接受戈尔康达的宗主权，向苏丹进贡。

english:
Nander, or Nanded, stands on the Godavari in the Deccan. It is especially sacred to Sikhs as the place where Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru, spent the last part of his life. The riverbank settlement became a place of remembrance and pilgrimage for the community far from its homeland in Punjab.

Guru Gobind Singh came to Nanded in 1708. Before his death there that year, Sikh tradition holds that he entrusted the authority of the Guru to the scripture, the Guru Granth Sahib, ending the line of personal Gurus. A shrine grew at the site associated with his final camp and cremation. In the nineteenth century Maharaja Ranjit Singh sponsored the building of Hazur Sahib, whose principal gurdwara was constructed between 1832 and 1837. The sanctuary links Nanded with Sikh communities across the subcontinent.
simp_chinese:
南德尔即南代德，坐落在德干的戈达瓦里河畔。这里是锡克教徒尤其尊崇的圣地：锡克教第十位古鲁戈宾德·辛格在人生最后一段时间居于此地。这座远离旁遮普故土的河畔聚落，成为教团纪念与朝圣的所在。

1708年，古鲁戈宾德·辛格来到南代德，并于当年在此去世。锡克传统认为，他临终前将古鲁的权威交予经书《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》，结束了由个人继承古鲁的传统。与他最后营地和火化地点有关的地方逐渐形成圣所。十九世纪，马哈拉贾兰吉特·辛格资助修建哈祖尔·萨希卜，其主要谒师所于1832至1837年建成。这座圣所将南代德与次大陆各地的锡克社群联系起来。

english: Ñandeva is a name used by Guarani-speaking communities in southern South America. Their language belongs to the Tupi-Guarani family, and relationships between villages extend across a broad region of forest, rivers and grasslands. In southern Brazil Guarani communities encountered Jesuit missions and colonial expansion; the mission towns and their cattle estates became part of the history of the uplands and the Uruguay basin.
simp_chinese: 南德瓦是南美洲南部使用瓜拉尼语的社群所用名称。其语言属于图皮—瓜拉尼语族，村落之间的关系跨越森林、河流和草原组成的广阔地区。在巴西南部，瓜拉尼社群与耶稣会传教区及殖民扩张相遇；传教城镇和牧场成为高地与乌拉圭河流域历史的一部分。

english: Nandgram, later known as Rajnandgaon, lies west of Durg near the Shivnath River. Its ruling estate grew from the fortunes of a Vaishnava religious household. Tradition traces the family to Prahlad Das, a shawl merchant who came from Punjab to Ratanpur near the end of the eighteenth century. His disciple Hari Das acquired an estate through moneylending, and Hari Das’s disciple Ram Das obtained Nandgaon in settlement of a loan. The name is associated locally with Nanda, the foster father of Krishna, whom the family worshipped.
simp_chinese: 难陀伽罗摩后来称为拉杰南德冈，位于杜尔格以西、希夫纳特河附近。当地统治领地源于一个毗湿奴派宗教家族的财富。传统将家族起源追溯至十八世纪末从旁遮普来到拉特纳普尔的披肩商人普拉赫拉德·达斯。他的弟子哈里·达斯通过放荷取得领地，哈里·达斯的弟子拉姆·达斯又因一笔贷款的偿付取得南德冈。当地将地名与家族所崇奉的克里希纳的养父难陀联系起来。

english: Nandian lies among the river valleys southwest of Tengchong. Its Tai chiefs held a hereditary domain that became entangled in the struggle between the Ming and the powerful rulers of Luchuan. In 1437 the chief Dao Gonghan appealed to the Ming court after Si Renfa of Luchuan seized hundreds of villages under his authority. Nandian's rulers aided the later Ming campaigns against Luchuan and were elevated to the rank of pacification commissioners.
simp_chinese: 南甸位于腾冲西南的河谷地带，傣族土司在此世袭统治。明朝与强大的麓川政权争斗时，南甸亦卷入其中。1437年，土知州刀贡罕向朝廷申诉，称麓川思任发夺走其辖下数百村寨。南甸土司后来协助明军征讨麓川，因功升为宣抚使。

english: Nandod stands near the Narmada River in the hilly country of Rajpipla. It became the seat of the Gohil rulers of Rajpipla, whose territory extended through the hills between the Narmada and Tapti rivers. The ruling house moved its residence from the older hill capital to Nandod in the eighteenth century. From this new seat the chiefs governed a landscape of wooded uplands and river valleys, negotiating their position among the stronger powers of Gujarat.
simp_chinese: 南多德位于拉杰皮普拉山地、纳尔马达河附近，后来成为拉杰皮普拉戈希尔统治者的驻地。他们的领地延伸于纳尔马达河与塔普蒂河之间的山岭。十八世纪，统治家族从较早的山地都城迁居南多德，并以新驻地治理林木高地与河谷交错的地区，同时在古吉拉特较强大的势力之间周旋。

english: The upper Guandu valley lies among the wooded hills of inland Espírito Santo. Streams descend through the rugged country toward the Rio Doce, whose course reaches the Atlantic farther north. In the first half of the nineteenth century Frederico Wilmer sought gold in this region and found it at a place called Lagoa, on the Santo Antônio do Alto Guandu estate. The settlement later called São Sebastião do Alto Guandu grew in the same upland country.
simp_chinese: 瓜亚杜河上游河谷位于圣埃斯皮里图内陆森林覆盖的丘陵之间。溪流穿过崎岖地带流向多西河，后者在更北处注入大西洋。十九世纪上半叶，弗雷德里科·维尔默在这一地区寻找黄金，并在上瓜亚杜圣安东尼奥庄园一处名为拉戈阿的地方发现了金矿。后来称为上瓜亚杜圣塞巴斯蒂昂的聚落也在这片高地形成。

english: Nandun was an old county on the eastern Henan plain. At the end of the Western Han, its magistrate Liu Qin was the father of Liu Xiu, the future Guangwu Emperor. The county was later renamed in honour of the emperor and then restored to its old name under the Tang. It remained attached to Chenzhou until the Song, when the separate county was abolished.
simp_chinese: 南顿是河南东部平原上的古县。西汉末年，县令刘钦是后来建立东汉的光武帝刘秀之父。南顿此后曾以光武为名，唐代恢复旧称，隶属陈州；宋代撤销南顿县，旧城仍保存着早期历史的记忆。

english: Nandurbar is an old town of Khandesh, near the country where Gujarat and Malwa meet the northern Deccan. Its surrounding fields produced millet and cotton, and cloth from the neighbouring countryside entered regional trade. In 1370 Malik Raja, the first Faruqi ruler of Khandesh, captured Nandurbar and Sultanpur, but was soon driven back by the ruler of Gujarat. In 1536 Muhammad Shah III of Gujarat granted the two places to Mubarak Khan Faruqi, fulfilling a promise made while he was confined at Asirgarh. Later in the century Akbar transferred the districts from Khandesh to Malwa. An inscription on a shrine and mosque outside Nandurbar records its construction during his reign.
simp_chinese: 南杜巴尔是坎德什的一座古城，附近便是古吉拉特、摩腊婆与德干北部相接的地区。周围田地出产小米和棉花，邻近乡间的布匹也进入地区贸易。1370年，坎德什首位法鲁基统治者马利克·拉阇攻占南杜巴尔和苏丹普尔，但很快被古吉拉特统治者击退。1536年，古吉拉特的穆罕默德沙三世将两地授予穆巴拉克汗·法鲁基，兑现了自己被拘于阿西尔加尔时许下的诺言。本世纪晚些时候，阿克巴将这两个地区从坎德什划归摩腊婆。南杜巴尔城外一座圣祠与清真寺的铭文，记载了它建于阿克巴统治时期。

english: Nandyal lies between the Nallamala and Erramala ranges in Rayalaseema. Its name is associated with Nandi, the bull who serves as Shiva's mount, and nine shrines dedicated to Shiva form a pilgrimage circuit around the town. Among the sacred places of the surrounding country is Mahanandi, whose temple has early stone foundations attributed to the Chalukyas. The rulers of Vijayanagara gave land to temples in the region, including Mahanandi, Ahobilam and Srisailam. After the empire's defeat at Talikota in 1565, the wider country came under Golconda and later the Mughals. In 1800 the Nizam of Hyderabad ceded it to the East India Company, which administered it from Madras.
simp_chinese: 纳恩迪亚尔位于拉亚拉西马的纳拉马拉和埃拉马拉山脉之间。它的名字与湿婆的坐骑神牛南迪有关，城镇周围的九座湿婆神庙组成了“九南迪”朝圣路线。周边圣地还包括摩诃南迪，神庙早期的石造基础被认为出自遮娄其时代。毗奢耶那伽罗统治者向这一地区的寺庙赐地，其中包括摩诃南迪、阿霍比拉姆和斯里赛拉姆。1565年帝国在塔利科塔战败后，广大地区先后转归戈尔康达和莫卧儿统治。1800年，海得拉巴尼扎姆将其割让给东印度公司，由马德拉斯方面管理。

english:
Nanfeng lies in the Xu River country of eastern Jiangxi, among hills and orchards. Its villages have long performed nuo, a ritual dance in which masked figures drive away harmful spirits and seek protection for the community. Performances belong to village temples and seasonal ceremonies, joining religious observance with dance and music.

In the early Ming, villages including Shanggan, Shiyou and Nanbao rebuilt or founded temples for the nuo gods and restored their rituals. Performers passed down masks and movements through local groups, while later descriptions recorded ceremonies held in family halls. The endurance of these practices gave Nanfeng a distinctive place in the ritual culture of the river basin.
simp_chinese:
南丰位于江西东部旴江流域，丘陵之间有村落与果园。当地流传傩舞，戴面具的舞者驱逐不祥、为乡里祈求安宁。表演与村庙、时令祭仪相连，结合了宗教仪式、舞蹈和音乐。

明初，上甘、石邮、南堡等村新建或重建傩庙，恢复傩礼。地方班社代代传承面具与舞步，后来的记载还描绘了家族厅堂中的傩仪。这些延续的习俗使南丰在旴江流域的礼仪文化中独具特色。

english: Nanga Parbat rises above the great bend of the Indus at the western end of the Himalayas. Known as Diamer in Shina, its vast snowy summit towers over deep valleys and long glaciers. The mountain's steep faces descend towards the Indus and the surrounding valleys of Diamir, Rakhiot and Rupal. It forms a formidable landmark where the high Himalayan chain meets the mountain country of the upper river.
simp_chinese: 南伽峰耸立在印度河大转弯之上，位于喜马拉雅山脉西端。希纳语称它为迪亚默，巨大的积雪峰顶俯瞰深谷和漫长冰川。陡峭山壁向印度河及周围迪亚默、拉基奥特和鲁帕尔山谷下降。在喜马拉雅高山与上印度河山区交会处，这座巨峰是令人望而生畏的地标。

english: Nangana lies near the meeting of the Cuito and Cubango rivers, around Dirico. Both rivers descend from Angola's highlands; together they feed the Okavango, whose waters spread into a vast inland delta rather than reaching the sea. Farther south, the channel passes the Popa rapids before entering the delta country.
simp_chinese: 南加纳位于奎托河与库邦戈河汇合处附近，靠近迪里科。两河都从安哥拉高地流下，共同汇入奥卡万戈河；河水并不入海，而是在内陆散开，形成广大的三角洲。更南面的河道经过波帕急流，再流入三角洲地区。

english:
Nangchen lies in the mountain country of eastern Tibet, along the upper Mekong known as the Dza Chu. Its kingdom emerged from a confederation of local groups in the thirteenth century and endured under a line of Tibetan kings. Monasteries of the Kagyu traditions became prominent in its valleys; Tana Monastery, founded in 1068, was one of its early religious centres.

The rulers of Nangchen maintained ties with both neighbouring Tibetan powers and the dynasties of China. Their authority encompassed lay communities and monasteries, whose relationships with the royal house shaped the kingdom. Mountain pastures and river valleys joined a network of religious centres across the land, giving Nangchen a distinctive place among the kingdoms of Kham, where valleys and high passes separated neighbouring centres of power.
simp_chinese:
囊谦位于藏东山区，地处称为扎曲的澜沧江上游。十三世纪，当地群体联合形成囊谦王国，此后由藏族国王世系统治。噶举派寺院在河谷中占有重要地位，1068年建立的塔纳寺是早期宗教中心之一。

囊谦统治者与邻近藏族势力及中国历代王朝保持联系。王权涵盖世俗社群与寺院，寺院和王室之间的关系塑造了王国。山地牧场与河谷连接起各处宗教中心，使囊谦在康区诸王国中拥有独特地位；河谷与高山垭口将各个权力中心分隔开来。

english: Nangch'ŏn lies among the mountains and tributaries of the North Han River. In Koryŏ times its relay stations formed part of the road network linking Ch'unju with the northern interior. The scholar Kim Sisŭp withdrew to this district after King Sejo seized the throne in the fifteenth century. The county was absorbed into Kimhwa in 1644, but restored under its own name in 1653.
simp_chinese: 狼川位于北汉江支流与群山之间。高丽时期，当地驿站属于春州通往北部内陆的道路网络。十五世纪世祖夺取王位后，文人金时习退隐至这一地区。1644年狼川并入金化，1653年又恢复为独立的狼川县。

english: Nanghaer lies in northern Sakhalin, an island linked by sea and river routes to the lower Amur. Ainu elders visited the post at Nanghar to offer tribute and receive gifts under the Yuan, making these encounters part of a wider exchange in furs and other goods. In the early fifteenth century the Ming court also established a Nanghaer guard and granted a title to a local leader, extending its network of relations across the strait.
simp_chinese: 囊哈儿位于库页岛北部，海路和河道将岛屿与黑龙江下游联系起来。元代，阿伊努长老到囊哈儿据点进贡并接受赏赐，这些往来也是毛皮及其他货物广泛交换的一部分。十五世纪初，明廷亦设囊哈儿卫，授予当地首领官职，将其关系网络延伸至海峡彼岸。

english:
Nángōng lies on the plains of southern Hebei and takes its name from Nangong Kuo, one of the Eight Gentlemen of the early Zhou, who held it as his fief. The Han made it a county. In the Song it was merged into Xinhe in 1052 and restored in 1073, and in 1232 the Mongols again split the neighbouring county of Xinhe from it, leaving the district with the borders it kept in later centuries.

Within the county stood the Putong Temple and its pagoda, reputed to be the earliest Buddhist pagoda in China and founded under the Eastern Han. Under the Ming, Nangong was a county of Jizhou in the northern capital region; in 1724 the Qing made Jizhou a directly administered department.
simp_chinese:
南宫位于冀南平原，因西周“八士”之一南宫适的封邑而得名。汉代在此立县。北宋皇祐四年（1052年）并入新河县，熙宁六年（1073年）恢复建制；蒙古太宗四年（1232年）又从南宫分出新河县，南宫的县境自此与后来的范围大致相同。

县境内有始建于东汉的普彤寺和普彤塔，相传是中国最早的佛塔。明代，南宫是京畿冀州所辖的县；1724年，清朝将冀州升为直隶州。

english: Nanhai lies in the waterways of the Pearl River delta, west of Guangzhou. Its district included Shiwan, a centre of pottery making whose kilns produced jars, tiles and other wares for the surrounding region. The industry grew particularly prosperous from the middle of the Ming. A temple for pottery makers was built in 1528, when many artisans still combined work at the kiln with farming. As the trade expanded, more people specialised in pottery; by 1817 a local inscription recorded more than forty kilns producing jars and tiles in Shiwan.
simp_chinese: 南海位于广州以西的珠江三角洲水网中。历史上的县境包括石湾，当地窑场烧造缸、瓦等陶器，供应周围地区。 明代中叶以后，石湾陶业逐渐兴盛。1528年建起陶师庙，当时不少陶工仍兼事耕作。随着生产扩大，专门从事制陶的人越来越多；1817年的碑刻记载，石湾已有四十多处缸瓦窑。

english: Nánhúdàshān rises to 3,742 metres in the northern part of Taiwan's Central Mountain Range. Its high ridges and steep valleys form part of a rugged mountain barrier between the island's western and eastern slopes. Indigenous communities travelled and settled across these mountains long before roads crossed them. Farther south, Truku groups crossed the range towards the eastern river valleys in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, seeking new places to hunt and cultivate.
simp_chinese: 南湖大山耸立在台湾中央山脉北段，海拔3742米。高岭与陡谷构成岛屿东西两侧之间的险峻屏障。早在道路开通以前，原住民社群便在山间迁徙定居；在更南方，太鲁阁人在十七至十八世纪越过中央山脉，进入东部河谷寻找新的猎地和耕地。

english:
Nanhui lies on the low coast south of the Yangtze estuary, where land formed from river and sea sediments spreads east of an old shoreline. Salt makers worked the coastal flats at the Xiasha salt field, and their production groups gave several settlements names ending in tuan. Sea walls protected the reclaimed land against tides and storms.

In 1386 the Ming built a fortified post at Nanhui to defend the coast against raiders. The salt field remained under the administration of the Liangzhe salt monopoly, with several production groups scattered across the district. In 1726 the Qing separated Nanhui County from Shanghai County, giving the coastal settlements an administrative centre of their own.
simp_chinese:
南汇位于长江口以南的低平海岸，古海岸线以东是江海泥沙淤积而成的土地。灶户在下沙盐场煮海制盐，盐业生产组织“团”也留下了许多地名。海塘保护垦地，抵御潮水与风浪。

1386年，明朝在南汇设守御千户所，防备海上袭扰。下沙盐场隶属两浙盐政，灶户分布于沿海各团。1726年，清朝从上海县划地设南汇县，使这片滨海地区有了自己的县治。

english: Nanhui Cape lies at the southeastern edge of the Yangtze delta, between the river mouth and Hangzhou Bay. Its low, flat land was built from sediment carried down the Yangtze and deposited through the action of river currents and tides. Here the great river’s alluvial plain meets the coastal waters of the East China Sea.
simp_chinese: 南汇嘴位于长江三角洲东南缘，介于长江口和杭州湾之间。长江携带的泥沙在河流与潮汐的共同作用下逐渐淤积，形成了这片低平的土地。大河的冲积平原在此与东海沿岸水域相接。

english: Nanja lies in the dry country north of the Murray River, near the borderlands of the lower Darling basin. Mallee scrub and sandy plains extend between river corridors, with water concentrated in creeks and occasional lakes. The Murray and Darling waterways supported Aboriginal communities whose connections and movement reached beyond the riverbanks into the surrounding interior.
simp_chinese: 南贾位于默里河以北干旱地区，靠近达令河下游流域的边缘。桉树灌丛和沙质平原分布在河流走廊之间，水源集中于溪流和间歇性湖泊。默里河与达令河水系支持原住民社群，他们的联系和活动从河岸延伸至周围内陆。

english:
Nanjangud lies on the Kapila River south of Mysore and takes its name from Nanjundeshwara, a form of Shiva revered as the Lord who drank poison. His great temple, also known as the Srikanteshwara temple, made the town a celebrated Shaiva pilgrimage centre. Tradition connects the deity with the poison churned from the cosmic ocean, which Shiva swallowed to save the world. The temple complex grew over many centuries and received gifts from the rulers of Mysore.

The Mysore court took a particular interest in the shrine. The temple was enlarged under Nandi Raja and later under the minister Purnaiah, while royal patrons installed lingams in its halls. Images of Krishnaraja Wodeyar III and his queens stand in attitudes of worship. A local tradition also tells how Tipu Sultan honoured the god after a favourite elephant recovered its eyesight, calling him a healer. Such stories and royal benefactions helped sustain the reputation of Nanjangud well beyond its riverbank.
simp_chinese:
南姜古德位于迈索尔以南的卡皮拉河畔，得名于南姜德什瓦拉，即传说中饮下毒液的湿婆。供奉这位神祇的斯里坎特什瓦拉大寺使此地成为著名的湿婆派朝圣中心。相传诸神搅动乳海时产生剧毒，湿婆将其吞下以拯救世界。寺院历经数百年扩建，也得到迈索尔统治者的捐献。

迈索尔宫廷尤其重视这座神庙。南迪·拉贾及后来担任大臣的普尔奈亚先后扩建寺院，王室施主还在殿内供奉林伽。克里希纳拉贾·瓦迪亚尔三世及其王后的塑像以礼拜的姿态立于寺中。当地还流传蒂普苏丹心爱的象恢复视力后，他尊崇此神、称其为医者的故事。这些传说与王室捐助共同维系了南姜古德远播的声誉。

english:
Nanjiang belongs to the northern Sichuan mountain country associated with Bazhou, where valleys and passes connect the basin with the Qinling approaches. Cultivation occupied usable strips of land, while wooded slopes supplied timber, fuel, and other products. Routes through the mountains linked local markets with neighboring districts, making small settlements useful to travelers as well as farmers. River crossings and dependable paths mattered greatly in terrain where a short distance could require substantial effort.

The historical county of Nanjiang was restored under the Ming in the early sixteenth century and renamed, its first syllable now written with the character for 'south'. Accounts differ on the precise year. The Micang road crossed the mountain region, and inscriptions along its route record use over successive dynasties. These passages linked northern Sichuan with lands beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese:
难江属于巴州相关的四川北部山地，河谷和山口把盆地连接到秦岭方向。耕作利用有限适宜地块，林坡供应木材、燃料及其他产品。山间道路联系地方市场和邻区，使小聚落同时服务农民及旅人。渡口与可靠小径格外重要，地形可能让不远距离也需付出很大劳动。

明代十六世纪初复置县治，并由难江改称南江；不同记载对具体年份有分歧。米仓古道穿越这一山区，沿线题刻记录了历代使用道路的痕迹。这些通路将川北与山外地区联系起来。

english: Nankang lies west of Ganzhou in the valley of the Zhang River. Its villages and hills formed part of Nan'an Prefecture under the Ming and Qing. At Tanbang, a lineage built a fortified settlement with five gates, modelled on the walls of Ganzhou. According to a family genealogy, Tan Qiaoche had served with Wang Yangming in the campaigns against armed groups at Tonggang and Hengshui. His relatives funded the new enclosure in the early sixteenth century to shelter their descendants.
simp_chinese: 南康位于赣州以西的章水流域，明清时期属南安府。县中谭邦村仿照赣州城格局修筑堡寨，设五座城门。据谭氏族谱，谭乔彻曾追随王阳明平定桶冈、横水等地武装；十六世纪初，族人集资建城，以庇护后代。

english:
Nanlang lies among the frontier settlements between southern Yunnan and Annam. The mines of Dulong and Nandan drew labourers and merchants into this border country, where village fields, tax payments and the authority of local headmen crossed the competing claims of distant courts. Kaihua's officials looked south towards these settlements, while Annam's rulers defended the possessions administered by their own frontier chiefs.

In 1725 Governor-General Gao Qizhuo named Nanlang, Mengkang and Nanding among the villages he claimed for Yunnan. Old tax registers, abandoned guard posts and the course of the Duzhou River became arguments in the dispute. Annam challenged the proposed boundary, and the Yongzheng Emperor cautioned his officials against seeking profit or merit through territorial demands. Nanlang thus entered an imperial controversy in which a mine, a stream and a village's former tax obligations could all become reasons to move a frontier.
simp_chinese:
南狼位于滇南与安南之间的边境村寨地带。都龙、南丹的矿场吸引矿工与商贩前来，村寨的田地、钱粮和土目所辖之境，也牵涉两方朝廷的疆界主张。开化官员向南清查这些村寨，安南君臣则维护本国边目掌管的地方。

1725年，云贵总督高其倬将南狼、猛康、南丁等寨列入要求划归云南的土地。旧粮册、废弃塘房和赌咒河的流向，都成了争界的依据。安南反对所拟界线，雍正帝则告诫地方官员，不可借争地谋利邀功。于是，南狼卷入一场直达朝廷的争议：一处矿场、一条溪流，乃至一寨从前向谁纳粮，都可能成为重新划界的理由。

english: Nanle lies on the flat lands south of Daming, in a region shaped by the changing courses of the Yellow, Zhang and Wei rivers. Northwest of the county town is a shrine and tomb traditionally associated with Cangjie, the legendary inventor of writing. The temple was rebuilt during the Ming Chenghua reign and repaired again in 1494, sustaining a local tradition of honouring the sage.
simp_chinese: 南乐位于大名以南的平原，黄河、漳河与卫河的改道塑造了这一地区。县城西北有仓颉庙和陵墓，供奉传说中的造字圣人。庙宇在明成化年间重建，1494年再次修缮，延续了当地祭祀仓颉的传统。

english: Nanling lies south of the Yangtze in the Qingyi River basin. Its hills contain ancient copper mines, including the Dagongshan workings, where miners and smelters laboured from the Zhou through the Tang and Song. Archaeologists have found furnaces, roasting kilns and underground galleries among the remains. The Tang poet Li Bai lived in Nanling on several occasions and wrote of leaving its children behind as he set out for the capital. The county later produced Ding Zi, who helped compile the great Yongle Encyclopedia under the Ming.
simp_chinese: 南陵位于长江以南的青弋江流域，山中有大工山等古铜矿。自周代至唐宋，矿工与冶工在此劳作，留下矿井、焙烧窑和冶炉。唐代诗人李白曾多次寓居南陵，写下离别儿女、入京求仕的诗篇。明代南陵人丁鎡则参与编纂了规模宏大的《永乐大典》。

english: West of Wugang, mountain ridges rise between the upper waters of the Zi and the country farther west. The region lies where the southeastern slopes of the Xuefeng range approach the northern edge of the Nanling mountain belt. Wooded heights stand above the hills and valleys surrounding Wugang, marking a transition from the lower country of southern Hunan toward the higher lands of the west. The ranges form part of the broad mountain rim around the province.
simp_chinese: 武冈以西，群山耸立于资水上游与更西方地区之间。这里是雪峰山东南麓接近南岭北缘的地带，林木覆盖的高岭俯瞰武冈周围的丘陵与谷地。山势由湘南较低的地带向西部高地过渡，也是环绕湖南的广大山地边缘的一部分。

sources.title: 1700204883赧水武冈城区水运码头建设工程 (2).pdf

english: The Nanling ranges stretch across the borderlands of southern China. Around Quanzhou, the mountains rise between Guangxi and Hunan, with forested slopes and valleys breaking the long succession of ridges. The ranges include the Yuecheng and Dupang mountains, part of the chain traditionally known as the Five Ridges. Their heights stand between the river basins of the Yangtze and the Pearl River, while lower gaps offer routes through the hills.
simp_chinese: 南岭横亘于中国南方的交界地带。在全州附近，山岭耸立于广西与湖南之间，林木覆盖山坡，山谷隔开绵延的群峰。越城岭和都庞岭均属传统所称的五岭。山地位于长江与珠江两大流域之间，较低的山口则为翻越群山提供了通道。

english: The Nanling forms a great belt of mountains between Hunan and the lands to its south. In this part of the range, the Jiuyi Mountains extend from the Mengzhu Ridge, their nine peaks rising above the wooded slopes of southern Hunan. The highest is Shunyuan Peak. Streams born in these mountains feed the Xiao River and tributaries of the Pearl River, separating waters that eventually find their way to different seas.
simp_chinese: 南岭是湖南与岭南之间绵延的山地屏障。这一带的九嶷山由萌渚岭向北、向东伸展，九座山峰耸立于湘南林坡之上，以舜源峰最高。山中的溪流分别汇入潇水和珠江支流，最终流向不同的海域。

english: The Nanling Mountains form a broad barrier between Guangdong and the lands to the north. Forested ridges divide the waters flowing towards the Pearl River from those of the Yangtze basin. Passes and old roads nevertheless cross the range: the route between Yizhang and Lechang linked communities on opposite sides of the mountains through many successive dynasties.
simp_chinese: 南岭群山横亘于广东与北方地区之间，林木覆盖的山脊分隔着流向珠江和长江流域的水系。山岭虽高，仍有古道越过隘口；宜章至乐昌的道路历代连接着山南山北的聚落。

sources.title: 乐昌市各级文物保护单位列表

english: Nanliu stood on the river of the same name in southeastern Guangxi. The Tang established the county in 621 from part of Beiliu, and in 996 it became the seat of Yulin Prefecture. The river flows south from this inland town toward the Gulf of Tonkin, giving the district an outlet to the sea. In 1369 the Ming abolished Nanliu County and incorporated its territory into Yulin, leaving the old county seat as the center of the prefecture.
simp_chinese: 南流位于广西东南部，以南流江得名。唐朝于621年从北流析地设县，996年这里成为郁林州治。南流江由内陆向南流往北部湾，使这一带拥有通向大海的水路。1369年，明朝撤销南流县并入郁林州，旧县城仍为州治所在。

english: Nanning is the seat of Qujing, a city on the eastern approaches to Yunnan. The rivers north and south of the town join the headwaters of the Nanpan River, while roads link the plateau with Guizhou and Sichuan. Earlier dynasties made this country a centre of government for the southwest; under the Yuan it became the seat of Qujing Circuit. The Ming advance into Yunnan in 1381 converged on Qujing from the north and east, recognising its importance as a gateway into the province. The following year the Ming made Qujing a prefecture, with Nanning as its seat. Military and civilian settlement brought new inhabitants, and the town continued as a centre of administration through the Qing.
simp_chinese: 南宁是曲靖府治，位于云南东部的门户。城南北的河流汇入南盘江上游，道路则将高原与贵州、四川相连。早期王朝曾以此地为西南行政中心，元代这里成为曲靖路治所。1381年明军进攻云南时，分别从北面和东面向曲靖会合，显示出它作为入滇门户的重要地位。次年明朝设曲靖府，治南宁县。军屯和民屯带来新的居民，城镇在清代继续作为行政中心。

english: Nannup lies beside the Blackwood River in the forested southwest of Australia. Its Noongar name has been interpreted as a stopping place or a place of parrots. Local Aboriginal communities used this river country before the arrival of settlers; Thomas Turner explored the district in 1834, decades before a townsite was laid out.
simp_chinese: 纳努普位于澳大利亚西南森林地区的布莱克伍德河畔。其努恩加地名被解释为停留之地或鹦鹉之地。定居者到来以前，当地原住民社群便利用这片河流地区；托马斯·特纳于1834年探访此地，而镇址要到数十年后才划定。

english: Nanpi lies on the low plain south of Cangzhou. Among its prominent local families were the Zhang, a lineage known for study and service in government during the Ming and Qing. Zhang Duancheng, born in 1756, passed the examinations and held office as far away as Yunnan. His career illustrates how education and the examination system could carry a family of the northern plain into the administration of distant provinces.
simp_chinese: 南皮位于沧州以南的低平地区。当地张氏是明清时期重视读书和仕宦的望族。1756年出生的张端城科举及第，曾远赴云南任职。他的经历展现了平原家族如何通过教育和科举参与遥远省份的行政事务。

english: Nánpíng stands at the meeting of rivers in northern Fújiàn. The Jiàn stream approaches from the east, while the Shā and Fùtún streams join to the west; their waters meet at the town and flow onward as the Mǐn River. Travellers from Fúzhōu could follow the river upstream to Yánpíng before taking routes through the mountains toward neighbouring regions.
simp_chinese: 南平坐落在福建北部的江流交汇处。建溪自东而来，沙溪与富屯溪在西面汇合，二水在城边相会后成为闽江。由福州出发的旅人可沿江上行至延平，再循山间驿路通往邻近地区。

english:
Nanrantsouak belongs to the Kennebec river world of Maine, where Abenaki communities cultivated crops, fished, hunted, and gathered resources across a forested landscape. River routes connected settlements and seasonal places, while canoe travel and portages maintained relationships with neighboring peoples. Food production and exchange relied on detailed knowledge of water, animals, plants, and weather. The region possessed its own political and social networks before colonial powers sought greater influence inland.

French missionary activity and trade became important parts of the wider Norridgewock setting, while English settlement and imperial rivalry brought growing pressure. Abenaki communities negotiated alliances and defended land and autonomy amid conflicts linking local places to Atlantic politics. The destruction of the mission village during eighteenth-century warfare was a particularly traumatic episode in this history.
simp_chinese:
南兰索阿克属于缅因肯纳贝克河世界，阿贝纳基社群在森林景观中耕作、捕鱼、狩猎并采集。河流路线连接聚落和季节地点，独木舟及搬舟通道维持同邻近民族关系。食物生产与交换依靠对水域、动物、植物和天气的细致知识。殖民强权试图深入内陆以前，地区已经拥有自身政治及社会网络，并持续安排资源使用和合作。

法国传教活动和贸易成为诺里奇沃克一带历史的重要部分，英格兰殖民定居与帝国竞争则带来日益增长的压力。阿贝纳基社群在这些与大西洋政治相连的冲突中协商联盟，保卫土地与自主。十八世纪战争期间传教村遭到摧毁，成为当地历史中尤其惨痛的一幕。

english:
The Nansemond lived along the river that bears their name, south of the James and near the waters later known as Hampton Roads. Their villages stood on both banks; fishing, oyster gathering, hunting and farming sustained a people who belonged to the Powhatan Confederacy. Across the sheltered harbor, the town of Norfolk would grow on the Elizabeth River.

Relations with the English at Jamestown soon became violent. In 1609 colonists raided the Nansemond leader's island, destroying sacred places and burial sites and taking valuables from their houses. As English settlement encroached during the seventeenth century, Nansemond communities were separated and displaced from their lands. Some remained along their river, while others moved toward the Nottoway; their descendants continued to identify as Nansemond.
simp_chinese:
南塞蒙德人居住在以他们命名的河流两岸，河流位于詹姆斯河南方，靠近后来称为汉普顿锚地的水域。他们属于波瓦坦联盟，以捕鱼、采集牡蛎、狩猎和耕作为生。隔着这处受遮蔽的港湾，诺福克镇后来在伊丽莎白河畔发展起来。

南塞蒙德人与詹姆斯敦英国移民的关系很快转为暴力冲突。1609年，殖民者袭击南塞蒙德首领所在的岛屿，毁坏圣所与墓地，并从屋中掠取贵重物品。十七世纪英国移民不断侵占土地，南塞蒙德社群被迫分散和迁移。一些人留在河畔，另一些人迁向诺托韦；他们的后裔继续保持南塞蒙德人的身份。

english: The Nansen forest belongs to the southern Patagonian Andes, a region of steep mountains, glaciers and long lakes. Moist air from the Pacific feeds the icefields and the cool forests on the western side of the range. Farther east, as the mountains shelter the land from rain, woodland gives way to the more open Patagonian steppe.
simp_chinese: 南森森林属于南巴塔哥尼亚安第斯山区，这里有陡峭的山岭、冰川和狭长的湖泊。来自太平洋的湿润空气滋养冰原和山脉西侧凉爽的森林。向东越过山脉的雨影地带，林地逐渐让位于更加开阔的巴塔哥尼亚草原。

english:
Nansheng belongs to the southern Fujian country associated with Zhangzhou, where cultivated valleys and wooded hills connect inland communities with coastal markets. Farming households used water and land according to local conditions, while craft production and forest resources supplemented income and supplies. Roads and streams carried goods toward larger settlements. The region's varied terrain encouraged exchange between communities producing different foods and materials.

In the late Ming and early Qing periods, kilns at Nansheng and nearby Wuzhai produced ceramics for trade. Blue-and-white and painted wares from the area reached overseas markets, connecting inland craftspeople to the maritime commerce of southern Fujian. Farming and local exchange remained important to the surrounding countryside, alongside the larger networks that carried pottery beyond China.
simp_chinese:
南胜属于与漳州相联系的闽南地区，耕作谷地和林木丘陵将内陆社区接入沿海市场。农户依地方条件使用水土，工艺生产及林产补充收入物资。道路和溪流将货物送往较大聚落，地形多样鼓励不同食物材料产区交换。居民生活因而既扎根土地，也依靠区域联系。

明末清初，南胜和附近五寨的窑场烧造贸易陶瓷。当地的青花和彩绘瓷器远销海外，将内陆工匠与闽南海上商业联系起来。农业和地方交换仍是周围乡村生活的重要组成部分，而更广的贸易网络则把瓷器运往中国以外。

english:
The Nantahala forest belongs to the southern Appalachian world of the Cherokee, where mountain valleys and wooded ridges supported communities through farming, hunting and gathering. Maize, beans and squash grew in suitable ground, while forests supplied game, plants and materials. Paths connected towns with different environments and with neighbouring peoples. Rivers and mountain passes gave structure to movement across country that could be difficult to cross without local knowledge.

Cherokee towns maintained political and ceremonial institutions connected through language, kinship and diplomacy. Kituwa, regarded as a Cherokee mother town in the wider region, was destroyed during the Anglo-Cherokee War. Trade, disease, warfare and settler expansion transformed relationships across the southern Appalachians. By the early nineteenth century, growing demands for Cherokee land had intensified pressures on community life and sovereignty.
simp_chinese:
楠塔哈拉森林属于切罗基人的南阿巴拉契亚地区。居民在山谷和林间从事耕作、狩猎与采集：适宜的土地种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，森林提供猎物、植物和材料。小路连接城镇与邻近族群，河流和山口构成穿越山区的重要通道。

切罗基城镇通过语言、亲属关系和外交维持政治及仪式联系。广大地区内的基图瓦被视为切罗基人的母镇，在英格兰与切罗基战争期间遭到摧毁。贸易、疾病、战争和定居者扩张改变了南阿巴拉契亚地区的关系。到十九世纪初，对切罗基土地的需求不断增长，社区生活与主权面临更大压力。

english:
Nantes stands on the Loire some fifty kilometres from the Atlantic, where the Erdre and the Sèvre join the river. Salt from the marshes of Guérande and wine from the Loire valley passed through its quays, and in the 15th century the dukes of Brittany made it their favourite residence. Duke John V began the cathedral of Saint-Pierre in 1434, and Francis II founded the first university in Brittany here in 1460 and rebuilt the ducal castle from 1466.

In 1341, as the War of Breton Succession opened, Jean de Montfort seized Nantes after the funeral of Duke John III. Anne, the last independent duchess, was born in the castle in 1477 and married Louis XII in its chapel in 1499, and the edict uniting Brittany with France was proclaimed at Nantes in 1532. In 1598 Henry IV issued the Edict of Nantes here, granting Protestants limited toleration until Louis XIV revoked it in 1685. In the 18th century Nantes became France's leading slave-trading port, its merchants sending ships that carried enslaved Africans to the Caribbean and returned with sugar. In 1793 Vendéen armies attacked the city, and afterwards the Revolutionary government's envoy drowned prisoners in the Loire.
simp_chinese:
南特位于卢瓦尔河畔，距大西洋约五十公里，埃德尔河与塞夫尔河在此汇入。盖朗德盐沼的盐和卢瓦尔河谷的葡萄酒经由它的码头转运，15世纪布列塔尼公爵们更以此为最喜爱的居所。约翰五世于1434年开始兴建圣皮埃尔主教座堂，弗朗索瓦二世于1460年在此创办了布列塔尼第一所大学，并自1466年起重建公爵城堡。

1341年布列塔尼继承战争爆发之际，让·德·蒙福尔趁约翰三世公爵葬礼之后夺取南特。末代独立女公爵安妮1477年生于城堡，1499年在城堡礼拜堂嫁给路易十二；1532年，布列塔尼与法国合并的敕令在南特颁布。1598年亨利四世在此颁布《南特敕令》，给予新教徒有限宽容，直到1685年路易十四将其废止。18世纪，南特成为法国最大的奴隶贸易港，商人装备的船只把被奴役的非洲人运往加勒比，又载着蔗糖返航。1793年旺代军队进攻该城，事后革命政府的特派员把囚犯投入卢瓦尔河溺死。

english: Nanthar Island lies off the Arakan coast near the mouths of the Mayu, Kaladan and Lemyo rivers. It is a low island of sandbanks, mangrove forest and intertidal mudflats, shaped by the river sediment and the ebb and flow of the Bay of Bengal. At low tide broad flats emerge around the island, providing feeding grounds for shorebirds. Its channels and sheltered margins belong to a larger estuarine landscape between river and sea.
simp_chinese: 南塔岛位于若开海岸外，靠近梅尤河、卡拉丹河与莱苗河的河口。岛地低平，沙洲、红树林和潮间泥滩由河流泥沙及孟加拉湾的潮水共同塑造。退潮时岛周围露出大片滩地，成为滨鸟觅食的场所。环岛水道与避风岸边共同构成河流与海洋之间广阔的河口景观。

english:
Nantucket lies south of Cape Cod, its sandy shores exposed to the Atlantic. Wampanoag communities lived on the island long before English settlement, under leaders known as sachems. In time the island became famous for whaling, with Wampanoag men serving aboard the vessels that sailed from its harbour.

English settlement expanded after Thomas Mayhew sold shares in the island in 1659. Early settlers farmed and raised sheep, but turned increasingly to the sea as pressure on the land grew. When the first harbour silted up, they dismantled houses and moved the settlement. The town, originally called Sherburne, took the name Nantucket in 1795. Freed African Americans established a neighbourhood known as New Guinea near its windmills, with homes, shops and churches. A building founded there in 1824 served as a school, church and meeting house. The island's maritime community also included Wampanoag people and Hawaiian sailors who had worked on its whaling ships.
simp_chinese:
楠塔基特位于科德角以南，沙岸面向大西洋。英国人定居以前很久，万帕诺亚格社群便在岛上生活，由称为萨切姆的首领治理。后来岛屿因捕鲸闻名，万帕诺亚格男子也在从港口出航的船上工作。

1659年托马斯·梅休出售岛上的股份后，英国移民逐渐增多。早期定居者耕作、养羊，但土地压力增长，促使他们越来越多地转向海洋。最初的港口淤塞后，他们拆下房屋，将聚落迁往别处。城镇原称舍伯恩，1795年改名楠塔基特。获得自由的非洲裔居民在镇上风车附近建立了新几内亚街区，逐渐有了住宅、商店和教堂。1824年建立的一座建筑兼作学校、教堂与会所。岛上的海洋社群还包括万帕诺亚格人，以及曾在捕鲸船上工作的夏威夷水手。

english: Nantucket Shoals stretch east and southeast from the island into the Atlantic, a maze of shallow banks crossed by strong currents. The water over some shoals is only a few feet deep, and the shifting bottom makes the passage hazardous. Nantucket whalers once hunted close to shore in small boats; as whales became scarcer near the island in the early eighteenth century, they began outfitting sailing vessels to pursue them farther offshore.
simp_chinese: 楠塔基特浅滩从岛屿向东和东南伸入大西洋，是一片受强劲水流穿过的浅滩迷宫。有些地方水深仅数英尺，变化的海床使航行十分危险。楠塔基特捕鲸人曾乘小船在近岸追逐鲸群；十八世纪初，随着岛边鲸群减少，他们开始装备帆船，前往更远的海面捕猎。

english: Nantwich stands on the River Weaver in Cheshire, where brine springs supported a salt-making industry for many centuries. Its market and timber-framed buildings reflect the prosperity of the old town. During the English Civil War Nantwich was held for Parliament and besieged by Royalist forces. On 25 January 1644 a Parliamentary army relieved the town and defeated the besiegers, securing an important foothold in Cheshire.
simp_chinese: 南特威奇位于柴郡威弗河畔，盐卤泉支撑了数百年的制盐业。市场和木架建筑体现了古镇的繁荣。英国内战期间，议会派守卫南特威奇，王党军队将其围困。1644年1月25日，议会军解救城镇并击败围攻者，在柴郡确保了重要立足点。

english: Nanumanga is a low reef island in northern Tuvalu, with small inland lakes rather than a large open lagoon. Oral traditions connect its settlement with voyagers from Tonga, and its language preserves close ties with Tongan. Its shores lie between the atolls of Nanumea and Nui, across stretches of open Pacific water.
simp_chinese: 纳努芒阿是图瓦卢北部的一座低矮礁岛，岛内有小湖而没有大型开阔潟湖。口传传统将岛上的定居与来自汤加的航海者联系起来，当地语言也与汤加语关系密切。岛屿位于纳努梅阿与努伊环礁之间，彼此隔着开阔的太平洋海面。

english: Nanumea is the northernmost atoll of Tuvalu, a chain of low coral islets enclosing a lagoon. Local tradition recalls Tefolaha, a founding ancestor who sailed from Samoa and later voyaged back toward Samoa and Tonga. Francisco Mourelle de la Rúa sighted Nanumea in 1781 while crossing the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 纳努梅阿是图瓦卢最北端的环礁，一串低矮珊瑚小岛围绕着潟湖。当地传统记述开创祖先特福拉哈从萨摩亚航行而来，后来又航向萨摩亚和汤加。1781年，弗朗西斯科·穆雷列·德拉鲁阿横渡太平洋时望见纳努梅阿。

english: Nanumea lies at the northern end of the Tuvalu island chain, with low islets set around a lagoon. Its oral traditions recall the founding figure Tefolaha and connections with other Pacific islands. In 1781 Francisco Mourelle passed the atoll aboard La Princesa on a voyage from the Philippines towards New Spain.
simp_chinese: 纳努梅阿位于图瓦卢岛链北端，低矮小岛环绕潟湖。当地口述传统记述了开创人物特福拉哈，以及与其他太平洋岛屿的联系。1781年，弗朗西斯科·穆雷列乘普林塞萨号从菲律宾驶往新西班牙途中经过这座环礁。

english: Nanuque lies in the Mucuri valley, where the river crosses the wooded eastern interior toward Bahia and the Atlantic. Indigenous communities known by names including Nak-Nanuk and Giporok inhabited this wider region before colonial settlement expanded along the river. Their lands formed part of the forest country contested by settlers and Indigenous peoples, particularly after the Portuguese crown authorised an offensive war against Botocudo groups in 1808.
simp_chinese: 纳努克位于穆库里河谷，河流穿过林木覆盖的东部内陆，流向巴伊亚和大西洋。殖民定居沿河扩展之前，包括纳克纳努克和吉波罗克等原住民社区居住在更广阔的地区。他们的土地属于定居者与原住民争夺的森林地带，尤其是在葡萄牙王室于1808年批准对博托库多群体发动进攻性战争之后。

english: Nanvaranak Lake lies among the waterways of the Yukon Delta. A slough runs northwest from the lake to Kwikpak Pass, one of the channels through which the Yukon approaches the Bering Sea. The lake belongs to a low, wet landscape threaded by rivers and side channels, with ponds and tundra extending between them. Fish and waterfowl use these waters, while the interconnected channels provide routes through the delta for the Yup’ik communities of the lower Yukon.
simp_chinese: 南瓦拉纳克湖位于育空河三角洲的众多水道之间。一条支汊从湖中向西北流入奎克帕克水道，后者是育空河接近白令海时分出的河道之一。湖泊周围地势低湿，河流与支汊纵横交织，其间散布池塘和苔原。鱼类与水鸟利用这些水域，相互连接的河道也为育空河下游尤皮克社群提供穿越三角洲的路线。

english: Nanwacinahaana lies near the upper Smoky Hill River in western Kansas. Around the river's basin southeast of Sharon Springs, water crosses a broad plain before continuing east through chalk country. Farther downstream, erosion has exposed striking bluffs and isolated formations in the Smoky Hills. The river eventually joins the Republican to form the Kansas River, linking this dry upland country to the Missouri basin.
simp_chinese: 南瓦奇纳哈纳靠近堪萨斯西部的斯莫基希尔河上游。沙龙斯普林斯东南方的河盆地中，水流穿过宽阔平原，继续向东进入白垩岩地区。下游斯莫基丘陵的侵蚀露出陡崖与孤立岩柱。斯莫基希尔河最终与共和河汇合，形成堪萨斯河，将干燥高地连入密苏里河流域。

english:
Nanwalek, “the place with a lagoon”, lies on the southern shore of Cook Inlet, where the Kenai Peninsula faces the waters of the Gulf of Alaska. Alutiiq families lived along this coast and moved between settlements and seasonal camps to harvest the resources of land and sea. In 1786 men of Grigorii Shelikhov’s fur-trading company established the fort of Aleksandrovsk here, linking the inlet to their operations on Kodiak Island.

The new post became caught in the rivalry between Russian trading companies. In 1793 men of Lebedev-Lastochkin’s company arrived with Dena’ina allies, assaulted local inhabitants and seized furs, though they failed to take the fort. The following year high tides and decaying buildings forced its occupants to move the post uphill. The fortress closed by 1818, while Nanwalek remained an Alutiiq home.
simp_chinese:
南瓦莱克意为“有泻湖的地方”，位于库克湾南岸，基奈半岛在此面向阿拉斯加湾。阿鲁提克家庭居住在这片海岸，在聚落与季节营地之间往来，获取陆地和海洋的资源。1786年，格里戈里·舍利霍夫的毛皮公司人员在此建立亚历山德罗夫斯克堡，将海湾与公司在科迪亚克岛的经营联系起来。

新据点卷入俄国贸易公司之间的竞争。1793年，列别杰夫-拉斯托奇金公司的人同德纳伊纳盟友到来，殴打当地居民、夺取毛皮，却未能攻下堡垒。次年，高潮和建筑腐朽迫使守军将据点迁往高处。堡垒在1818年前关闭，南瓦莱克仍是阿鲁提克人的家园。

english: Nanxi stands on the Yangtze downstream from Yibin, its old town enclosed by walls above the river. The county seat moved here in the tenth century, and the walls were repaired in the Ming after earlier defences had fallen into disrepair. The Wenming Gate, begun in the Zhengde reign, was rebuilt in 1764 under the Qing. Its gate tower watched over the streets within and the river traffic beyond.
simp_chinese: 南溪位于宜宾下游的长江边，旧城城墙临江而立。县治于十世纪迁至此地，明代又修复了年久失修的城垣。文明门始建于明正德年间，清乾隆二十九年即1764年重修；城楼俯瞰着墙内街道和墙外江面的往来船只。

sources.title: 宜宾市历史文化名城保护规划-说明书.pdf
sources.url: https://www.sc.gov.cn/10462/10778/10876/2023/1/16/1235a74c94284404979250f4308dabec/files/宜宾市历史文化名城保护规划-说明书.pdf

english:
Nanyang occupies a fertile basin between the mountains of central China. Long known as Wan, it was an important city under the Han and a meeting place of routes linking the central plains with the lands around the Han River. West of the city, Wolong Ridge is associated with Zhuge Liang, the strategist of the Three Kingdoms, who was said to have farmed here before entering Liu Bei's service. A shrine on the ridge commemorates him.

In the Ming, Nanyang became the seat of the princely house of Tang. A large palace was built in the Yongle reign, and further residences for members of the family followed. In 1641 Li Zicheng's army captured the city and killed the Prince of Tang. The city later recovered as merchants from Shanxi, Shaanxi and the lower Yangtze came to trade. In 1711 the prefect Luo Jing restored Zhuge Liang's shrine and laid out features evoking the stories of his life on the ridge.
simp_chinese:
南阳位于中国中部群山环抱的盆地中，古称宛。汉代这里已是重镇，中原与汉水流域之间的道路在此交汇。城西卧龙岗与三国谋臣诸葛亮相联系：传说他出仕刘备之前曾在此躬耕，岗上的武侯祠便是为纪念他而建。

明代南阳成为唐王藩府所在地。永乐年间，城中建起规模宏大的唐王府，宗室宅第此后陆续增多。1641年，李自成军攻破南阳，杀唐王。战后城市逐渐恢复，山西、陕西和江浙商人前来经营。1711年，知府罗景重修武侯祠，并依照诸葛亮躬耕的传说增建岗上诸景。

english: Lake Nanyi lies in the low country east of Xuancheng in southern Anhui. It is one of a chain of lakes formed as the ancient Danyang marsh gradually filled with silt and separated into smaller bodies of water. The Langchuan River enters from the northeast, and the lake drains westward toward the Shuiyang River and the Yangtze. Its broad, shallow waters collect runoff from the surrounding hills and spread across the plain when rains swell the rivers.
simp_chinese: 南漪湖位于皖南宣城以东的低地。古丹阳大泽逐渐淤积，分化出一串湖泊，南漪湖便是其中之一。郎川河从东北注入，湖水向西流入水阳江，最终通往长江。浅阔的湖面汇集周围山地来水，雨季河水上涨时，水势便漫及湖边平原。

english:
The Nanzatico lived on both sides of the Rappahannock River. Their community included people from neighbouring groups displaced by English settlement, among them Patawomeck and Rappahannock families. John Smith recorded their predecessors, the Nantaughtacund, on the river in 1608 and marked a leader's house on his map. Their leader Pattanochus joined the Treaty of Middle Plantation in 1680, but the colony did not prevent settlers from encroaching on their lands.

In 1704 the Nanzatico petitioned Virginia's House of Burgesses about further encroachment. Later that year a Nanzatico war party killed an English settler and his family. Colonial militia captured members of the community; five men were executed, and the other captives over twelve were sold into slavery in the West Indies. Younger children were forced into service in Virginia.
simp_chinese:
南扎蒂科人居住在拉帕汉诺克河两岸。社群中包括因英国移民扩张而离开故土的邻近族群，其中有帕塔沃梅克和拉帕汉诺克家庭。1608年，约翰·史密斯记载了他们的前身南托塔昆德人，并在地图上标出一座首领的住所。他们的首领帕塔诺克斯于1680年加入中部种植园条约，但殖民地未能阻止移民侵占他们的土地。

1704年，南扎蒂科人向弗吉尼亚众议院申诉进一步的土地侵占。同年稍后，一支南扎蒂科战队杀害了一名英国移民及其家人。殖民地民兵抓捕了社群成员：五名男子被处死，其他十二岁以上的俘虏被卖到西印度群岛为奴，年幼的孩子则被迫在弗吉尼亚服役。

english: Nanzewaspe was an Osage village in the Neosho valley of southeastern Kansas. The river flowed through a country of prairie and wooded bottoms, connecting the Osage homeland to the Arkansas River basin. Osage families planted crops near their villages and traveled onto the plains to hunt bison. Their communities lay between the eastern woodlands and the open grasslands, maintaining ties across both landscapes.
simp_chinese: 南泽瓦斯佩是堪萨斯东南部尼奥肖河谷的一座奥塞奇村落。河流穿过草原与林木覆盖的低地，将奥塞奇人的故土与阿肯色河流域联系起来。奥塞奇家庭在村落附近种植作物，并前往平原猎取野牛。他们的社群处在东部森林与开阔草原之间，与两种地带都保持联系。

english:
Nanzhang lies in the hills and valleys southwest of Xiangyang in Hubei. Cultivated land and mountain roads connect the Han River country with areas farther west. Across the region, farming households used valley water and terrain, while paths linked villages with markets and towns.

During the medieval and early modern periods, the wider Xiangyang region occupied an important position between northern China, the middle Yangtze and routes southwest. County officials, lineages and temples helped organise local affairs, while trade linked farming areas with nearby towns. Warfare could disrupt roads and supplies.
simp_chinese:
南漳位于湖北襄阳西南的丘陵和河谷地带。耕地与山间道路把汉江地区同更西方联系起来。广大地区的农户利用谷地水源和地形耕作，道路则连接村庄、市场与城镇。

中世纪至近代早期，襄阳地区位于中国北方、长江中游与西南道路之间的重要位置。县级官员、宗族和庙宇参与地方事务，贸易连接农区与附近城镇，战争则可能中断道路和供应。

english: Nanzhao lies in the hills north of Nanyang, along the old road toward Luoyang. A stopping place for travellers called Nanzhaodian gave its name to the county established here under the Ming in 1476. The county was later absorbed into Nanyang in the early Qing, then restored in 1734. Its local gazetteer records the work of officials and residents in gathering accounts of the territory, its people and its past.
simp_chinese: 南召位于南阳以北的山地，宛洛古道穿过此地。道路上的旅人歇宿之处南召店，给明朝1476年新设的县取了名字。清初南召并入南阳，1734年复置。地方官与士民搜集山川、人物和沿革资料，编成县志，保存了这一带的往事。

english:
Nanzheng stands in the Hanzhong basin, between the Qinling to the north and the mountains leading into Sichuan to the south. A county since ancient times, it became the seat of Hanzhong commandery under the Eastern Han. Its position made it the administrative centre of a fertile basin and a stopping place on the roads between the Wei valley and Sichuan.

During the Tang, the prefecture was renamed Xingyuan in 784 while the emperor was staying in the region. Nanzheng remained its seat under later dynasties. In 1370 the Ming changed Xingyuan's administrative name to Hanzhong prefecture, still governed from Nanzheng. A Qing county gazetteer described the county as the prefectural seat and recorded its boundaries against Chenggu, Baocheng and the mountains toward Sichuan.
simp_chinese:
南郑位于汉中盆地，北有秦岭，南有通往四川的群山。此地自古设县，东汉时成为汉中郡治。它坐落于富庶盆地的中心，也是渭河流域与四川之间道路上的重要城邑。

784年，唐帝驻于此地期间，梁州改名兴元府，治所仍在南郑。此后历代相沿；1370年明朝将兴元改为汉中府，继续以南郑为治所。清代县志记载了南郑作为府治的地位，以及它与城固、褒城和四川方向山地之间的疆界。

english: The country around Lake Naococane lies northeast of Lake Mistassini, near the northern Otish uplands. The lake's many islands rise from a great mass of glacial deposits, partly submerged after the ice withdrew. Its waters feed Lake Nichicun and the headwaters of La Grande Rivière; to the south lie the sources of the Eastmain. Both rivers eventually reach James Bay by separate courses across the northern interior.
simp_chinese: 纳奥科坎湖区位于米斯塔西尼湖东北方，靠近奥蒂什山地北部。湖中许多岛屿露出水面，来自冰川消退后部分被淹没的大量堆积物。湖水流入尼希昆湖，汇入大河上游；南方则是伊斯特梅恩河的源头。两条河各自穿过北方内陆，最终都流入詹姆斯湾。

english:
Naogaon lies in the northern Bengal plains, near the rivers and wetlands of the Atrai basin. In the surrounding country stands the mosque of Kusumba, on the western bank of the Atrai. Its brick structure is faced in dark stone, and its gently curved cornice and octagonal corner towers follow the characteristic style of Bengal.

An inscription above the central eastern entrance dates the mosque to 1558–59. It records that Sulaiman built it during the rule of Ghiyasuddin Bahadur Shah, one of Bengal’s Afghan rulers. Despite the Suri dynasty’s connections with northern India, the building follows local Bengali forms. The substantial mosque and its enclosed courtyard show the resources available to its patron and the importance of religious building in the region.
simp_chinese:
瑙冈位于孟加拉北部平原，邻近阿特赖河流域的河流和湿地。周边的库苏姆巴清真寺坐落在阿特赖河西岸，砖造建筑外覆深色石材；微微弯曲的檐口和八角形角塔体现了孟加拉的典型建筑风格。

东侧中央入口上方的铭文将清真寺的年代定为1558至1559年，并记载它由苏莱曼在孟加拉阿富汗统治者吉亚苏丁·巴哈杜尔沙时期修建。尽管苏尔王朝与印度北部有联系，这座建筑仍采用孟加拉本地形式。规模可观的清真寺与围合庭院，显示其赞助者掌握的资源，也体现这一地区宗教建筑的重要性。

english: Naoiri lies in the uplands of inland Bungo, around the castle town of Taketa. In 1594 Nakagawa Hidenari arrived from Miki in Harima and established the Oka domain. He strengthened Oka Castle and laid out a town below it, making Taketa a centre of the interior. The Nakagawa family continued to govern the domain through the Edo period, its mountain stronghold overlooking the valleys of southern Bungo.
simp_chinese: 直入位于丰后内陆高地，环绕竹田城下町。1594年，中川秀成从播磨三木迁来，建立冈藩。他整修冈城，在山下营建城下町，使竹田成为丰后内陆的中心。中川氏在江户时代继续统治此藩，山城俯瞰着丰后南部的河谷。

english: Naomao lies in the dry basin east of Barkol, beyond the eastern end of the Tian Shan. Beneath its arid surface lie coal-bearing beds formed from ancient peat deposits, evidence of an environment very different from the Gobi of later ages. The basin forms part of the inland country between mountain ranges, where cold winters and scant rain shape the open desert landscape.
simp_chinese: 淖毛位于巴里坤以东、天山东端之外的干旱盆地。荒漠地表之下是由古代泥炭沉积形成的含煤地层，见证了与后来的戈壁截然不同的环境。盆地属于山脉之间的内陆地带，寒冷冬季与稀少降水塑造了开阔的荒漠景观。

english: Napaktok Bay cuts into the northern Labrador coast near the northern limit of its trees. Inuit families lived along the bay, where the remains of sod houses mark the sites of former settlements. Seals gather in its sheltered waters: harbour seals frequent Shark Gut Harbour and the west side of Finger Hill Island, while the inner bay offers places to hunt ringed seals at their breathing holes in the winter ice. Islands and narrow passages give the bay a sheltered, intricate shoreline.
simp_chinese: 纳帕克托克湾深入拉布拉多北部海岸，接近树木分布的北界。因纽特家庭曾居住在海湾沿岸，旧聚落留下了泥草房屋的遗迹。海豹聚集在避风水域：港海豹常见于沙克古特港和芬格希尔岛西侧；冬季的内湾则可在冰面呼吸孔附近猎捕环斑海豹。岛屿与狭窄水道使海湾形成曲折而隐蔽的岸线。

english: Napaktulik Lake lies among the northern lakes of the Coppermine River basin. Its name means “the place where there are trees”, a striking description in a country of open tundra and long winters. Water leaves the lake by the Fairy Lake River, which joins the Coppermine on its northward course. The lake and its neighbours form part of a landscape crossed by caribou and known to generations of Indigenous travellers.
simp_chinese: 纳帕克图利克湖坐落在科珀曼河流域的北方湖区。湖名意为“有树的地方”，在这片冬季漫长、苔原开阔的土地上显得格外醒目。湖水流入费里湖河，继而汇入向北流去的科珀曼河。此湖与周围水域构成一片驯鹿迁徙之地，也是世代原住民旅人熟悉的地方。

english:
Napanee grew at a waterfall on the river of the same name, where navigation from the Bay of Quinte met a source of water power. The falls and surrounding lands had long formed part of an Indigenous lakeshore country; an Oneida village, Ganneious, stood in the wider bay region during the seventeenth century.

After the American Revolution, Loyalists settled around the bay. Mohawk families allied with Britain established a community at the mouth of the Napanee River in 1784. At the falls upstream, the government commissioned the Loyalist millwright Robert Clark to build mills in 1785. A sawmill and a gristmill served the new settlements, giving farmers a place to have their grain ground, and the place became known for a time as Clarksville.
simp_chinese:
纳帕尼兴起于同名河流的一处瀑布旁。这里既是从昆特湾上溯的通航终点，又能利用水力。瀑布与周围土地长期属于原住民的湖岸地区；十七世纪，奥奈达人村落甘尼厄斯曾坐落于更广阔的湾区。

美国革命后，效忠派在湾区定居。1784年，与英国结盟的莫霍克家庭在纳帕尼河口建立社区。上游瀑布处，政府于1785年委托效忠派磨坊匠罗伯特·克拉克修建磨坊。锯木厂和磨粉厂为新聚落服务，使农民有了磨粮的地方；这里一度因此称为克拉克斯维尔。

english: The Napetipi runs through the Labrador Peninsula to a bay on the north shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence. Its name comes from Innu tradition and has been interpreted as “the man's river.” Salmon travel its waters, which connect the forested interior to the coast. Innu families used the river as part of a wider country of lakes and forests, travelling inland to hunt and returning to the shore.
simp_chinese: 纳佩蒂皮河穿过拉布拉多半岛，流入圣劳伦斯湾北岸的一座海湾。河名来自因努传统，被解释为“男人的河”。鲑鱼游经河中，水道将森林内陆与海岸相连。因努家庭利用这条河和周围广大湖区、森林，沿水道深入内陆狩猎，再返回海岸与亲人会面。

english:
Napiniacá was the centre of the Chiapaneca people on the Grijalva River, near the entrance to the Sumidero canyon. Nearby stood a much older Zoque settlement, whose pyramidal platforms attest to a long history of occupation in the central depression of Chiapas. Mountains, springs, trees and the river formed part of the sacred landscape around the Chiapaneca town.

Spanish campaigns against Napiniacá began in 1524 and continued under Diego de Mazariegos in 1528. The colonial settlement of Chiapa developed beside the river, and Dominican friars sought to convert its inhabitants. Indigenous understandings of the landscape persisted through the new religious order, as local sacred places and Christian figures became intertwined in the religious life and traditions of the community along the river.

The later city of Tuxtla Gutiérrez lies here.
simp_chinese:
纳皮尼亚卡是恰帕内卡人的中心，位于格里哈尔瓦河畔，靠近苏米德罗峡谷入口。附近还有历史久远得多的索克人聚落，其金字塔形台基见证了恰帕斯中央洼地悠久的居民历史。山、泉水、树木和河流构成恰帕内卡城镇周围神圣景观的一部分。

西班牙人于1524年开始攻打纳皮尼亚卡，迭戈·德·马萨列戈斯在1528年继续征服。殖民城镇恰帕在河畔发展，多明我会修士试图使居民皈依。原住民对景观的理解在新宗教秩序中延续，当地圣地与基督教人物逐渐交织于河畔社群的宗教生活与传统之中。

后来的图斯特拉-古铁雷斯即位于此地。

english: Napituca was a town in the Timucua country of northern Florida. In September 1539 Hernando de Soto's expedition reached it while travelling toward Apalachee. Timucua warriors resisted the invaders, but the Spaniards defeated them and executed many captives in what became known as the Napituca massacre. The expedition continued westward through a landscape of villages and fields, leaving violence in its wake.
simp_chinese: 纳皮图卡是佛罗里达北部蒂穆夸人领地中的一座村镇。1539年9月，埃尔南多·德索托的远征队前往阿巴拉契途中抵达此地。蒂穆夸战士奋起抵抗，却被西班牙人击败；许多俘虏随后被处决，这一事件后来被称为纳皮图卡大屠杀。远征队继续向西穿过村落和田野，沿途留下暴行。

english: The forests of the Pacific slope west of the Colombian Andes are watered by heavy rains and numerous rivers. Near the Micay basin, steep wooded valleys descend from the Western Cordillera toward the coast. Gold mining spread into nearby river basins in the colonial period, bringing mine owners and enslaved African workers into a region already inhabited by Indigenous communities. Rivers remained the chief routes through the dense forest.
simp_chinese: 哥伦比亚安第斯山以西的太平洋坡地森林受到丰沛降雨和众多河流滋养。米凯河流域附近，林木覆盖的陡峭谷地从西部山脉向海岸下降。殖民时代，采金业扩展到邻近河流流域，矿主与被奴役的非洲劳动者来到原住民社群早已居住的地区。河流仍是穿越茂密森林的主要通道。

english:
Founded as the Greek colony of Neapolis around 600 BC on the shores of its spectacular bay, the city passed through Roman, Byzantine, Norman, and Hohenstaufen hands before the Angevin dynasty made it the capital of the Kingdom of Naples in 1266. Under the Angevins it became one of the great royal courts of medieval Europe and the most populous city in Italy, its port channeling the wealth of the Mezzogiorno toward the wider world. The court at Naples attracted scholars, artists, and theologians, among them Thomas Aquinas, who taught and died here, making it a center of intellectual life as well as dynastic power.

The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 cost the Angevins the island, but Naples stayed the capital of their mainland kingdom, and through the 14th century its court drew Tuscan bankers, Giotto, Boccaccio and Petrarch. In 1442 Alfonso of Aragon took the city from the last Angevin king, René, and gathered humanists around the new dynasty. After the Italian Wars the kingdom fell to Spain in 1503, and for two centuries Naples was governed by viceroys, the greatest of them Pedro Álvarez de Toledo, who rebuilt much of the city.

Under Spanish rule Naples grew into the largest city on the Mediterranean, second in Europe only to Paris. In 1647 a new tax on fruit, the staple food of the poor, set off the revolt of the fisherman Masaniello, which proclaimed a short-lived republic before Spanish rule returned, and in 1656 plague killed about half of its 300,000 people. Austria took the kingdom in 1707, but in 1734 the Bourbon prince Charles conquered it, and Naples became once more the capital of a king of its own.
simp_chinese:
约公元前600年希腊人在壮丽的那不勒斯湾的海滨建立了殖民地涅阿波利斯，并先后经历了罗马、拜占庭、诺曼和霍恩施陶芬家族的统治，直到1266年安茹王朝将其立为那不勒斯王国的首都。在安茹王朝统治下，它成为中世纪欧洲最伟大的王室宫廷之一和意大利人口最多的城市，其港口将南意大利的财富输送到更广阔的世界。那不勒斯的宫廷吸引了学者、艺术家和神学家，其中包括在此教学并逝世的托马斯·阿奎那，使其成为学术生活与王朝权力的双重中心。

1282年西西里晚祷事件让安茹家族失去了西西里岛，但那不勒斯仍是他们大陆王国的首都；整个14世纪，宫廷吸引着托斯卡纳的银行家，乔托、薄伽丘和彼特拉克也来到这里。1442年，阿拉贡的阿方索从最后一位安茹国王勒内手中夺取此城，人文学者纷纷聚集到新王朝周围。意大利战争中，王国于1503年落入西班牙之手，此后两百年间由总督治理，其中最有作为的佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多重建了城市的大片街区。

西班牙治下，那不勒斯成长为地中海沿岸最大的城市，在欧洲仅次于巴黎。1647年，当局对穷人赖以果腹的水果开征新税，激起了渔夫马萨尼埃罗领导的起义，起义者宣布成立一个短命的共和国，不久西班牙的统治便卷土重来；1656年，鼠疫夺去了全城30万人口中的约一半。1707年奥地利夺取了王国，但1734年波旁家族的卡洛斯王子征服此地，那不勒斯重新成为一位本国君主的都城。

english:
The Napo runs east from the Andean foothills through the forests of the upper Amazon. Its banks supported communities whose chiefs, cultivated maize and ornaments were described by early Spanish travellers. In 1541 Gonzalo Pizarro's expedition crossed the mountains from Quito; he sent Francisco de Orellana downstream in search of provisions. Orellana continued along the Napo and reached the Amazon in 1542, passing villages whose people knew the river long before his voyage.

The later city of Puerto Francisco de Orellana lies here.
simp_chinese:
纳波河从安第斯山麓向东流过亚马孙上游森林。河岸社群拥有首领、种植玉米、佩戴饰物，这些都见于早期西班牙旅人的记载。1541年，贡萨洛·皮萨罗率远征队从基多翻越群山，派弗朗西斯科·德·奥雷利亚纳顺流寻找补给。奥雷利亚纳继续沿纳波河前进，于1542年抵达亚马孙河；他途经的村落居民早已熟悉这条水道。

后来的科卡即位于此地。

english: The forests of the Napo stretch eastward from the Ecuadorian Andes into the upper Amazon basin. Rivers born on the mountain slopes descend through dense vegetation and join the Napo, which flows east to the Amazon. The upper basin was home to diverse Indigenous peoples, including the Quijos and other communities whose histories became intertwined through contact and the spread of Kichwa.
simp_chinese: 纳波森林从厄瓜多尔安第斯山麓向东延伸，进入亚马孙上游流域。发源于山坡的河流穿过茂密植被，汇入纳波河，后者向东流入亚马孙河。上游流域居住着包括基霍斯人在内的不同原住民社群，他们的历史随着相互接触和基丘亚语的传播而交织。

english: Napochi lies beside the Buttahatchee River in the wooded hills of northwestern Alabama. The river rises near Delmar and flows west to Hamilton, where it turns southwest. It eventually joins the Tombigbee in Mississippi, carrying its waters onward to Mobile Bay. Earthen mounds stand along the river south of Hamilton, traces of earlier Indigenous communities in the Buttahatchee valley.
simp_chinese: 纳波奇位于阿拉巴马西北部的林木丘陵中，靠近布塔哈奇河。河流发源于德尔马附近，向西流至汉密尔顿后转向西南，最终在密西西比境内汇入通比格比河，河水继续流向莫比尔湾。汉密尔顿以南的河畔有土丘遗迹，留下布塔哈奇河谷早期原住民社群的痕迹。

english: Napuka is a low coral atoll in the northeastern Tuamotus, its narrow islets surrounding a shallow lagoon. The people of Napuka and neighboring Tepoto met the British navigator John Byron in 1765. His crew found the reception hostile and named the pair the Disappointment Islands.
simp_chinese: 纳普卡是土阿莫土东北部一座低矮的珊瑚环礁，狭长小岛围绕着浅潟湖。1765年，英国航海者约翰·拜伦遇见纳普卡与邻近的特波托岛居民。船员认为对方态度敌对，遂将两岛称为失望群岛。

english: Napuka is a small coral atoll in the northeastern Tuamotus, separated from nearby islands by long stretches of sea. John Byron reached it in 1765 and named the group the Disappointment Islands after his reception. Polynesian people had reached these remote shores long before his voyage.
simp_chinese: 纳普卡是土阿莫土东北部的一座小珊瑚环礁，与附近岛屿之间隔着漫长海程。约翰·拜伦于1765年抵达，并因所受接待将这一岛群命名为失望群岛。早在他的航行之前，波利尼西亚人已抵达这些偏远海岸。

english:
Nara was the ancient capital of Japan and remained a great centre of Buddhist worship long after the imperial court departed. Tōdai-ji, founded under Emperor Shōmu, housed a colossal bronze image of the Buddha Vairocana. Through the Middle Ages the monks of Kōfuku-ji, the family temple of the Fujiwara, governed the province of Yamato, and the sacred deer of the Kasuga Shrine wandered the town.

In 1567 fighting between the Miyoshi and Matsunaga destroyed the Great Buddha Hall and badly damaged the statue. For years the Buddha stood exposed to the weather. The monk Kōkei gathered donations across Japan for its restoration, and in 1692 a ceremony celebrated the repaired image. Rebuilding the hall proved still more costly; completed in the early eighteenth century, it was narrower than its predecessor. Its dedication in 1709 marked a remarkable recovery for the ancient temple.
simp_chinese:
奈良曾是日本古都，皇室迁都之后，仍是重要的佛教中心。圣武天皇时建立的东大寺供奉着巨大的毗卢遮那佛铜像。中世时期，藤原氏的氏寺兴福寺实际掌管大和一国，春日大社的神鹿在城中随处游走。

1567年，三好氏与松永氏交战，大佛殿被焚，佛像严重受损，此后多年暴露于风雨之中。僧人公庆到日本各地募捐修复，1692年为修好的大佛举行开眼供养。重建大殿耗费更大，新殿于十八世纪初建成，规模比旧殿窄小；1709年举行落成供养，标志着古寺的重大复兴。

english: Naran Chila'un was a hunting ground visited by Ögedei Khan in the autumn and winter of 1232. His stay there followed a campaign in North China, and the court later moved on to other camps. The hunt is one episode in the seasonal journeys of the Mongol ruler and his followers.
simp_chinese: 纳伦奇拉温是窝阔台汗于1232年秋冬到访的猎地。窝阔台在华北用兵后到此驻留，后来又移往其他营地。这次狩猎是蒙古统治者与随从逐季迁徙的一段记载。

sources.title: 287125667 Imperial Itinerance and Mobile Pastoralism The State and Mobility in Medieval Inner Asia

english: The Naracoopa shore lies on King Island in Bass Strait, between Tasmania and mainland Australia. Beaches and coastal waters face the strait, where winds and currents can make navigation difficult. Aboriginal people knew the region long before European sealers entered Bass Strait in the late eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 纳拉库帕海岸位于巴斯海峡金岛上，介于塔斯马尼亚与澳大利亚大陆之间。海滩与沿海水域面向海峡，风与海流可能使航行困难。十八世纪末欧洲猎海豹者进入巴斯海峡之前，原住民早已熟悉这一地区。

english: Naraha lies on the Pacific side of Mutsu, where the Kido River runs from the Abukuma uplands to the coast. A fortified site above the river was known in medieval times as Yamada or Kido Castle. During the age of warring states the district came under the Iwaki family, and the castle is thought to have been held by their retainers, the Igari. The coastal country later formed part of the Iwakitaira domain.
simp_chinese: 楢叶位于陆奥太平洋一侧，木户川从阿武隈高地流向海岸。河畔高地上的城馆在中世称为山田城或木户城。战国时期，此郡归岩城氏支配，城馆被认为由其家臣猪狩氏驻守。后来这片沿海地区成为磐城平藩的一部分。

sources.title: 23930 1 常磐自動車道遺跡調査報告.pdf

english: Naran lies in western Mongolia, between the mountains of the Gobi Altai and the dry basins of the Valley of the Lakes. To the east the Khangai range feeds rivers that end in inland lakes, while rocky hills and desert steppe extend westward. The contrast between mountain watercourses and arid basins shapes this broad transition from highland to Gobi.
simp_chinese: 纳兰位于蒙古西部，地处戈壁阿尔泰山与湖谷的干旱盆地之间。东方杭爱山脉为流入内陆湖泊的河流供水，岩丘和荒漠草原则向西延伸。山地水道与干旱盆地形成的对照，塑造了这片从高地过渡到戈壁的广大地带。

english: Narungga country encompasses Yorke Peninsula, between Spencer Gulf and Gulf St Vincent. Four clans occupied different parts of the peninsula: Kurnara in the north, Windera in the east, Wari in the west and Dilpa in the south. Narungga people met their Kaurna and Nukunu neighbours for trade and ceremony, and used fire to manage vegetation and encourage fresh growth.
simp_chinese: 纳兰加人的土地涵盖约克半岛，位于斯潘塞湾与圣文森特湾之间。四个氏族分别居住在半岛不同地区：北部的库尔纳拉、东部的温德拉、西部的瓦里和南部的迪尔帕。纳兰加人与考纳、努库努邻居会面，进行贸易和仪式，并用火管理植被、促进新草生长。

english: Narat lies in the Kunes valley in the eastern Ili country. Along the river, mountain grassland rises towards the Tian Shan, with spruce woods on the slopes and summer pastures above. The Nalati grasslands provide grazing for herds moving between the valley and higher ground. The Kunes joins other rivers of the Ili basin beyond the mountain meadows.
simp_chinese: 巩乃斯位于伊犁地区东部的巩乃斯河谷。河边山地草原向天山升高，山坡上有云杉林，较高处则有夏季牧场。那拉提草原供在河谷与高地之间迁移的畜群放牧；巩乃斯河流出山间草甸后，与伊犁流域的其他河流汇合。

english:
Narbonne grew near the Mediterranean at the meeting of the Roman roads to Italy and Aquitaine. Its archbishops left a great palace beside the cathedral, while the medieval town spread on both sides of the old course of the Aude. The river's changing course altered the city's connection with the sea, and boats later used the channel known as the Robine.

In the eighteenth century the people of Narbonne sought better access to the Canal du Midi.
